title: members see a display name; the legal name stays with the platform

criteria.text: Signup requires a legal name; no account without it
criteria.note: [V] built half: the profile screen requires 2-120 characters (signup/profile.ts, OnboardingFlow, handler signup-profile-set; #497, review-skipped). Missing half: members.legal_name is nullable (migration 20261007200000), nothing forces a signed-in member to /onboarding unless the phone gate is on (proxy.ts, phone.ts), and since #946 (2026-10-18) the live way in is /auth/login, email then code, which lands on `next` (default /) and never on /onboarding, so a new member uses the app with no legal name at all. Ticket #847 is the fix (now F081.1's gap too); check ticket #610. unmarked: profile.test.ts, onboarding/actions.test.ts, OnboardingFlow.test.tsx, signup-profile-set.test.ts

criteria.text: Display name shown wherever a peer would see the legal name
criteria.note: [V] the display name is collected at signup (OnboardingFlow, #497 review-skipped) and is what every peer-facing surface shows: a Page's 'Started by' line reads page_founder_public, which returns display_name only (migration 20260930180000, #249, no Reviewed by, deploy-health green on aba449d), and the following list shows followed people's display_name (get-member-follows.ts). legal_name is rendered nowhere (grep 2026-10-23: the signup path, the admin queue's comment and tests). Posts are by Pages, responses do not exist and the member profile is retired (/m/[handle] 404s, #303), so these are every surface the criterion names that exists. Smoked: page and /you/following opened green (2026-10-19 cd913c7, 10-23 cb892a7). No test asserts display over legal on any of them

criteria.text: Legal name never on a public or discovery surface or shown to an anonymous visitor
criteria.note: [V] members has only members_select_self (migration 20260930180000, #249, no Reviewed by; deploy-health green on aba449d); the only src files that name legal_name are the signup path, the admin queue's comment and tests (grep 2026-10-23). Behavior holds today; no standing guard, ticket #611. Smoked: explore and page, the public surfaces, opened green 2026-10-23 (cb892a7), though the smoke looks for stray emails, not names

criteria.text: Operator report view shows legal name beside display name
criteria.note: [V] the column exists since #497, but src/lib/admin/reports-queue.ts:30 still says 'there is no members.legal_name column' and ReportEntry.tsx:95 shows display name and handle only (reread 2026-10-23). Ticket #608

criteria.text: Seeded/test members backfilled with a legal name or flagged
criteria.note: [V] migration 20261007200000 adds legal_name nullable with no default and no backfill, and no later migration touches it (grep 2026-10-23); no flag or marker for members without one. Ticket #609
